name: walkcroach-ide
description: You steer; we explore → act → verify. Memory-first coding agent with propose→confirm approvals, BYOK Bedrock, and cross-surface CockroachDB recall (no silent production mutate).

walkcroach.ide.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the WalkCroach IDE BFF (/ide/*).

walkcroach.ide.webAppUrl.description: WalkCroach Web app URL used for Sign In (shared Cognito account).

walkcroach.ide.cognitoClientId.description: Cognito SPA app client ID (same as WalkCroach Web).

walkcroach.ide.cognitoRegion.description: AWS region for the Cognito user pool.

walkcroach.ide.bedrockRegion.description: AWS region for Bedrock Runtime. Short-term Bedrock API keys only work in the region where they were created (often us-east-1). Must match that region.

walkcroach.ide.bedrockModelId.description: Optional Bedrock model ID override. Empty uses Nova 2 Lite (global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0) or BEDROCK_NOVA_MODEL_ID. Amazon Nova 1 Pro is not supported.

enumDescriptions: Low effort — fastest; best for routine UI/CSS edits
Medium effort — default; same tier as WalkCroach Web App Builder
High effort — slowest, most thorough (disables the output-token cap)
walkcroach.ide.reasoningEffort.description: Nova 2 Lite extended-thinking tier (always on). Empty uses medium. Prefer low for routine edits to cut latency; use medium/high for hard design or multi-file refactors. Off is not offered — thinking cannot be disabled.

walkcroach.ide.mcp.allowStdio.markdownDescription:
Allow `.walkcroach/mcp.json` to start MCP servers by **running a program on this machine** (stdio transport).

Off by default. Turning this on means a repository you clone can propose a command to run; WalkCroach still asks for explicit per-server approval, refuses commands inside the workspace, and never passes AWS/GitHub/CockroachDB credentials to them. This setting cannot be changed by a workspace — only in your user settings.

walkcroach.ide.includeUserGlobalSkills.description: Scan ~/.cursor/skills and ~/.walkcroach/skills for Agent Skills (in addition to workspace and bundled skills).

walkcroach.ide.skillRoots.description: Extra skill directories (absolute paths or paths relative to the workspace root). Merged with default workspace roots and user-global skills.

walkcroach.ide.phaseGraph.description: Enable Gather→Act→Verify tool remasking and phase-local prompts (improves Nova 2 Lite tool selection). Off restores the flat full tool menu.

walkcroach.ide.forcePlanOnRisk.description: P3 dual validation: force plan-then-execute for large/risky tasks (multi-file, migrate, refactor, architecture) before Act.

walkcroach.ide.architectureCritic.description: P3 dual validation: run a read-only architecture critic after verify (instead of the generic verify-review). Off keeps legacy verify-review.

walkcroach.ide.toolRank.description: P4: Titan-rank optional Act tools and prune the schema to ≤12 (keep-always + top hits). Off offers the full Act allowlist.

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:publishable && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o walkcroach-ide.vsix
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run package:vsix && npm run check:publishable && npx --yes ovsx publish walkcroach-ide.vsix
